entities.summary: Aki Pekka Antero Sirkesalo was a Finnish singer and broadcaster. He and his family tragically lost their lives during the 2004 Indian Ocean tsunami while on holiday in Khao Lak, Thailand, a disaster that claimed over 230,000 lives across multiple countries.
